topic.title: 架空の業務資料：太陽光設備の保全

assets.label: 発電監視
assets.meaning: 太陽光パネルの発電状況を監視する。数値や実績のグラフは作らない。
assets.subject: A recognizable flat solar panel grid with a small monitoring meter showing a simple nonnumeric indicator.
avoid: No invented generation figures, trend chart or performance claim.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 設備点検
assets.meaning: 担当者が設備を点検し、不具合の有無を記録する。図は点検手順を表さない。
assets.subject: A simplified closed inverter cabinet with a small inspection wrench and one visible service-status indicator.
avoid: No invented wiring, open live electrical internals or detailed repair instructions.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 作業許可
assets.meaning: 保守作業の前に隔離と作業許可を確認する。これは安全操作の手順書ではない。
assets.subject: A conceptual disconnected isolator-switch symbol with a lockout tag and a small blank permit card, purely explanatory.
avoid: No exact electrical circuit, sequential safety instructions or energised repair depiction.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 復旧確認
assets.meaning: 作業終了後、担当者が復旧状態を確認して記録する。稼働再開を自動化したと示さない。
assets.subject: A restored closed equipment cabinet with a separate final-inspection clipboard and a single confirmation check.
avoid: No autonomous restart arrow or guaranteed zero-downtime claim.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning
